name: Unreal-style docking, panels and entity tabs
body:
# Unreal-style docking, panels and entity tabs

Dean (2026-11-18): the editor should feel like using Unreal Engine. Keep most settings out of the main viewport and add
shortcuts to open the toolbars and panels needed; have tabs for windows where individual entities and components are
edited, with the hierarchy and inspector on the right.

Slices, each its own small PR: dock the outliner and details on the right with panel toggles and shortcuts; slim the
viewport header and move view options into menus; document tabs (Level plus one per opened entity); a component list
and per-entity editing inside an entity tab.
